# access.ApprovalRequest

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A four-eyes approval request for an action whose permission requires approval.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `access.ApprovalRequest` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.approval.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | yes | `personal` | The action to run once approved. |  |
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the request was created (UTC). |  |
| `decidedBy` | yes | `personal` | Approver or rejecter; null while pending. |  |
| `expiresAt` | yes | `none` | When a pending request expires (UTC), 7 days after creation. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Automatic id of the request. |  |
| `node` | yes | `none` | Node where the action runs; approvers need its permission there. |  |
| `permission` | yes | `none` | Permission of the action (one that requiresApproval). |  |
| `reason` | yes | `personal` | Reason given with the decision. |  |
| `requestedBy` | yes | `personal` | Who asked; never allowed to approve. |  |
| `status` | yes | `none` | Lifecycle state. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization of the request. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the request last changed (UTC). |  |

## Relations

- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Organization` via `tenantId`
